question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 14,641 in 4 years at 10% p.a. when interest is compounded annually. What will be the amount of the same sum (in Rs.) in 3(2)/(5) years at the same rate at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum amounts to Rs. 14,641 in 4 years at 10% p.a. when interest is compounded annually.

**Formula used:**

A = P [1 + (r/100)]ⁿ

A = Sum of total amount and compound interest

P = The total sum

r = Rate of interest

n = Time (years)

**Calculation:**

Let, the sum of amount = x

14641 = x [1 + (10/100)]⁴

⇒ (11)⁴ = x (11/10)⁴

⇒ 1 = x/10000

⇒ x = 10000

∴ The sum of the amount = Rs. 10000

Total interest in 3{2over5} years = (17/5) × 10 = 34%

The total amount will become = 10000 + [10000 × (34/100)] = 10000 + 3400 = Rs. 13400

**∴ The sum of the amount (in Rs.) in 3(2)/(5) years at the same rate at simple interest is Rs. 13400**
